topic: Original conversation transcript ('Arcadia CA Development Insights')
notes: The transcript was not delivered with the commissioning brief and is absent from the repository and its issue tracker. The relayed inventory in intake-artifact.md is the preserved record. Other channels (the author's chat exports) were not searchable from this environment.

topic: Parcel-level deed/assessor chronology for station-area parcels (pre-2016 assembly question)
notes: LA County assessor/recorder parcel history is not retrievable through open web sources from this environment. Only the April 2024 JV purchase is publicly documented. Pre-2016 acquisitions neither confirmed nor excluded. Next durable step: county recorder grantor/grantee index pull (trail-deed-chronology). Resolved this increment via trail-deed-chronology (see resolution field).
resolution: LA County Assessor parcel-detail records, combined with trade-press reporting, resolve the pre-2016 assembly question for the four target sites with documentable chains: every reassessable ownership change found (Azalea 2018/2019, Arroyo 2019, Derby 2020, Town Center partial-interest 2024/2026) postdates the 2016-03-05 station opening. No current player is shown holding these parcels before the station opened. The assessor API withholds owner names and deed identifiers, so a non-reassessable or affiliate holding cannot be fully excluded, and the pre-2024 Town Center ownership chain stays open (see cov-10).

topic: DAIA Form 990 PDFs page-by-page (exact officer windows); reported $20,000 city contribution (2023-05-16 agenda)
notes: Officer data taken from ProPublica's rendering; the specific agenda packet was not inspected. Resolved this increment via trail-wahl-title and trail-daia-formation.
resolution: ProPublica's full-text renderer exposed the exact IRS e-file officer rows for every available filing year (FY2015, FY2017-FY2025; FY2016 source document is not released by the IRS), giving precise office windows for Erik Wahl. The 2023-05-16 agenda packet was downloaded in full and text-extracted, resolving the reported $20,000 contribution as Resolution 7497, a fireworks/Patriotic Festival sponsorship appropriation, not a general operating grant.

topic: City agenda archive for parking-lot ENAs/DDAs and station cost-share agreements
notes: Station cost-share funders are now named (Measure R, FTA grant, Construction Authority/Metro, City of Arcadia GO bonds — see clm-station-funding-structure), though exact dollar splits for the city betterment/plaza contribution and the FTA grant remain unpublished in any retrieved source (see cov-20). Parking-lot ENA/DDA/sale keyword sampling was extended (exclusive negotiation, disposition and development agreement, surplus land, sale of city property) with no council action found; CIP books instead show the city reinvesting capital in the lots. A page-by-page crawl of roughly 250 agendas was not completed.
